name: Commercial Packaging
old_description: Tear- and puncture-resistant woven polypropylene (WPP) is ideal for retail packaging.
about:
Commercial Packaging was founded in 1983 by Gary and Janette Egbers in Bloomington, Illinois. After Gary’s death in 2004, Janette Egbers continued as chairwoman, president, and CEO, and the company remains family‑owned and operated. Headquartered in central Illinois, the business began as a packaging supplier and has grown into a global provider of packaging products and services.

The company supplies woven polypropylene bags, flexible intermediate bulk containers (FIBC), multiwall bags, flexible packaging, and stock pouches. It manages a network of manufacturing partners in the United States, China, Vietnam, Brazil, Indonesia, India, Thailand, and Mexico, and operates multiple warehousing locations across the U.S. Services include package design and engineering, artwork design, technical field support, vendor‑managed inventory, safety‑stock and consignment programs, and full logistics management including customs brokerage and freight forwarding. Thousands of businesses worldwide rely on Commercial Packaging for packaging solutions, design services, and technical expertise.

Customers span the food, agriculture, and animal‑nutrition sectors. Specific markets served include pet food and animal nutrition, seed and grain, chemical, dairy, food ingredients, diatomaceous earth, and salt and sugar. Testimonials cite clients in the global food industry, agriculture, and animal industries.

Commercial Packaging emphasizes supply‑chain management that navigates international regulations, language, and cultural barriers; technical expertise through dedicated product managers who consolidate specifications and right‑size packaging; quality oversight via on‑site processes at overseas plants; and dedicated U.S.-based account specialists who understand each customer’s usage patterns. The company’s WBENC and C‑TPAT certifications, along with an ASI‑certified warehouse, underscore its commitment to secure, compliant supply chains.
